definitions.explanation: The state of being free from harm, accident, or trouble.
Completing something without problems or accidents.

examples.japanese: ⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{無事|ぶじ}⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
⟦{全員|ぜんいん}→全員：03310_zenin⟧{無事|ぶじ}⟦だった→だ：09496_da⟧。
⟦{地震|じしん}→地震：01608_jishin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{後|あと}→後：09580_ato⟧、⟦{友達|ともだち}→友達：01478_tomodachi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{無事|ぶじ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確|たし}かめた→確かめる：01955_tashikameru⟧。
examples.english: After the earthquake, I confirmed that my friend was safe.

examples.japanese: {無事|ぶじ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{着|つ}きました→着く：00680_tsuku⟧。
⟦{試験|しけん}→試験：01422_shiken⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{無事|ぶじ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{終|お}わりました→終わる：00567_owaru⟧。
examples.english: The exam finished without any problems.
It was a long trip, but I was able to get home safely.

notes:
{無事|ぶじ} indicates safety or the absence of problems.

FORMS:
- Adverbial: {無事|ぶじ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ (safely, successfully)
- Na-adjective: {無事|ぶじ}な (safe)
- Noun: {無事|ぶじ} (safety)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {無事|ぶじ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{着|つ}く→着く：00680_tsuku⟧ (arrive safely)
- {無事|ぶじ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{終|お}わる→終わる：00567_owaru⟧ (end without incident)
- {無事|ぶじ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{祈|いの}る→祈る：01198_inoru⟧ (pray for safety)
- ⟦ご→お〜：03097_o⟧{無事|ぶじ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧ (take care/be safe)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
「⟦お→お〜：03097_o⟧{無事|ぶじ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{何|なに}→何：00498_nani⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧」(I'm relieved you're safe) - common polite expression
